verdict_text:
YES

The script verifies identical name sets across all three checkpoints and bit-exact equality of every non-MLP tensor in ft1 and ft2 against base before any merge, aborting via assertion on failure. It computes the 64 MLP merges in float32 against the unmodified base (both task vectors taken from `b`, never from a partially merged tensor), casts back to the base dtype, and takes all other tensors from base unchanged. It asserts exactly 64 merged and exactly 244 output tensors, then writes a single `out/T4/model.safetensors`.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
